verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's SDK and CLI are explicitly designed for fully on-device inference across LLM, STT, TTS, and VLM, with docs stating prompts/audio/images 'stay on the phone' and hosted execution is only used when explicitly requested via --cloud (runanywhere-docs-3, docs-6, docs-10, docs-13, docs-35, gh-1). A Hacker News commenter independently confirmed 'Fully local - no data is collected!!' (runanywhere-comm-2), corroborating the privacy claim. Missing for 10: independent technical audit of network traffic to verify zero telemetry, and some community reports of install/runtime bugs (segfaults, broken installs) slightly undercut confidence in real-world reliability of the local path even though they don't contradict the no-data-leaves-device claim itself.
